mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_LOG (CHAT_ID, MEMBER_ID, MESSAGE, RESPONSE, AI_CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_AI_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{message}, #{response}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE, RESPONSE FROM ( SELECT MESSAGE, RESPONSE, AI_CREATED_AT FROM AI_LOG WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MESSAGE IS NOT NULL AND RESPONSE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY AI_CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ORDER BY AI_CREATED_AT ASC
